book.name: ROMANS
book.title: Paul ROME ep Tuptsiwni’yuṅqamuy amumi Pēniata

content: Do Not Judge Your Brother
Uma hakiy tuptsiwnit aṅ qa öqalat pās taviyamantani, nīk̇aṅw hihta tuptsiwniyat ep qa amum nāṅwuy’yuṅwni.
Pay suhk̇a sohsok hihta tūmoytaniqey tuptsiwni’taṅwu; noqw pu suhk̇a qa öqala sikwit qa tūmoytaṅwu.
Tūmoytaqa it qa tūmoytaqat aw qa ye’tay’tani; pu i’ qa tūmoytaqa it tūmoytaqat aqw qa hiṅqawlawni, taq God pay put kwusu.

Ya um haknihqe God tumal’ayayat aqw hiṅqawlawu? Ason pi pam God‐niqw sen suan hinmaṅwu, sen qa suan hinmaṅwu. Noqw nu nātuptsiwni’taqw pam soon qa suan hinmani; pi pam pan hinmaniqat God put eṅem yúkuniqey aw öqala.
Suhk̇a hihtawat talöṅnit pas hihtay’taṅwu; pu sukwniqw pay sohsoy suntaṅwu. Uma nanāp umuhwuwniy aṅ qa wiwsiyani.

Talöṅnit k̇aptsi’taqa Tutuyqawhqat eṅem put k̇aptsi’taṅwu, pu piw put qa k̇aptsi’taqa pay Tutuyqawhqat eṅem put qa k̇aptsi’taṅwu. Sikwit tūmoytaqa Tutuyqawhqat eṅem put tūmoytaṅwu, God aw put ep hahlayhtimaqee; pu i’ put qa tūmoytaqa piw pay Tutuyqawhqat eṅem put qa tūmoytaṅwu, nihqe God aw hahlayhtima.
Pi qa hak súneṅem qatu, piw qa hak súneṅem mōki.
Pi itam yesqe Tutuyqawhqat eṅem yēse; pu itam soe’ Tutuyqawhqat aw yank̇ahk̇aṅw so’ni. Noqw ōviy nāmahin pi itam yesni, sen so’ni, itam Tutuyqawhqat himumatu.
Pi yantaniqw ōviy Christ mōki, pu ahoy tātayi, pam so’pumuy amumi‐nik̇aṅw pu yesqamuy amumi tutuyqawniqe ōviy’o.
Noqw ya um hinoqw uhtupkoy aqw hiṅqawlawu? Hal ya um hinoqw uhtupkoy qahihtalawu? Pi itam sohsoyam Christ haqam sinmuy hin yukunaniqat atpip hoṅvani.
Pi ura yan pey’ta: Nu hapi suyan qatu, kita Tutuyqawhqa; noqw pan hapi pas suyan sohsoyam inumi tamötshoṅvani, noqw sohsoyam God aw nātuhtualyani.
Noqw ōviy itam hapi sohsoyam God aw nālavaytani.
Do Not Make Your Brother Fall
Oviy itam pāpu nānamiq hihta aṅ qa hiṅqaqwani; itam qa panyuṅwt yanwat wūwantotani, qa hak tupkoy atpik hihta ep múnukniqat hintsakni, sen hihta ep múnuk̇e’ qaanhtiniqata.
Pi nu navoti’ta, nu Tutuyqawhqat Jesus aṅqw pan tuptsiwa; pas qa himu nȫsiwhqa nāp nahpe itséhee; nīk̇aṅw himu hákiyniqw itséheenen pam put eṅem itséheeniṅwu.
Noqw kurs uhtupko uhnösiwhqay akw unaṅwmokq pahsat pay kurs um put aw qa unaṅway’taqat antani; um Christ hakiy eṅem mokqat uhnösiwhqay akw qa hovalani.
Oviy hapi uṅniqw himu lolmanihqat qa hak put qalomáyuaatani.

Pi hak sikwit nösqa, sen ovavalat hikwqa qa pam hapi God tunatyayat aṅ hinma, piw hak put qa nösqa, sen qa hikwqa qa pam’i; nīk̇aṅw hak suan hinme’ piw kwakwhat unaṅway’te’ put tunatyayat aṅ hinmani. Pam hapi Qahováriwtaqat Hikwsit ahpiy hahlayhpit pasiwtani.
Pam hapi Christ eṅem tumalay’me’ God unaṅwveni, pu sinmuy amumi lomahintani.
Noqw ōviy itam hin yep pās unaṅwat yesniqey aṅ ö’qalyani, pu hihta akw nāwuṅwnayaniqeyu.
Um qa sikwit ōviy God tumalayat sakwítani. Pay as pas sohsoy himu nȫsiwhqa kwaṅw’eway’o; nīk̇aṅw hak hihta tūmoytaqey akw hakiy unaṅwmoknaniqw pam qa súanta.

Pay hak tupkoy tunatyawk̇aṅw qa sikwínösat pu sen ovavalat qa hīkwe’ sen nāp hintsakpiy mēwe’ súanhtini. Noqw pep pu’ put tupkoat put hintsakpiyat qa akw múnukni, piw qa unaṅwmokni, piw qa tūtsakwiwtani.
Kurs um sikwit tūmoytaniqey qapēvewne’ um God atpip nāla pantani. Ya um sikwit tūmoytaniqey nānakwhantoyna? Kurs um put akw qa nāsoontsane’ um hahlayhpit epni.
Pu i’ wiwsik̇aṅw nösqa hapi pay qalomáhinhtiṅwu, pam qatuptsiwni’k̇aṅw panhtiṅwuniqe ōviy’o; pi hak qatuptsiwni’k̇aṅw hihta hintsak̇e’ qaanhtiṅwu.
